name: Beijan
description: Beijan develops AI-powered autonomous systems for the Indian Armed Forces, including autonomous navigation modules for GPS-denied UAV operations, autonomous artillery positioning systems, and swarm control software for coordinated battlefield operations.

name: DheyaTech
description: DheyaTech designs and manufactures indigenous small gas turbine engines (micro turbojets) for unmanned aerial systems and distributed power generation, with thrust capacities ranging from 20 kgf to 400 kgf. The company also develops hydrogen-based flexi-fuel systems and proprietary adaptive engine control units.

name: VerifAIX
description: VerifAIX develops an AI-powered, spec-first verification platform that uses formal verification methods to transform chip design specifications and RTL code into executable verification plans, testbenches, and coverage workflows. The platform helps semiconductor teams accelerate chip verification processes.

name: Airbound
description: Designs and manufactures lightweight autonomous vertical-flight drones for cargo delivery applications, serving healthcare, e-commerce, and logistics sectors with their tail-sitter aircraft design.

name: Alteon
description: Alteon develops fixed-wing autonomous drones using dynamic soaring technology that harvests wind energy for extended flight endurance. The aircraft are designed for maritime surveillance applications targeting government customers.

name: Anscer Robotics
description: Anscer Robotics manufactures Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs) for warehouse and factory automation, handling material handling tasks including pallet movement, lifting, stacking, and trolley transport in industrial settings.

name: Bioscan Research
description: Bioscan Research develops non-invasive medical devices using near-infrared spectroscopy and machine learning to detect traumatic brain injuries and intracranial hemorrhages. Their flagship product, CEREBO, is a portable detector designed for rapid diagnosis in trauma centers, emergency wards, and first-response settings.

name: C2i Semiconductors
description: C2i Semiconductors develops software-defined voltage regulator platforms and power stage chips for AI data center power delivery systems.

name: Cellogen Therapeutics
description: Cellogen Therapeutics develops CAR-T cell therapies and gene therapies to treat blood cancers and genetic disorders such as beta-thalassemia and sickle cell disease. The company uses advanced cellular engineering and CRISPR-based approaches to design and manufacture these treatments.

name: Clear Robotics
description: Clear Robotics builds all-electric autonomous unmanned surface vessels for maritime surveying, waste removal, and water management tasks. Their fleet performs services for port authorities, municipalities, and environmental organizations.

name: Dhruva Space
description: Develops satellite platforms, launch deployers, and ground stations for satellite communications and space missions. Provides end-to-end space engineering solutions including satellite manufacturing, launch integration, and ground operations.

name: Discovered Materials
description: Develops AI agents to discover novel semiconductor materials, focusing on thermal management solutions to address extreme heat dissipation challenges in AI chips.

name: Estro Tech Robotics
description: Estro Tech Robotics develops interactive robotic platforms for retail marketing (RobAd combines robotics with light, sound, and AI analytics) and advanced inspection robots for infrastructure and utility management applications.

name: Flo Mobility
description: Flo Mobility builds autonomous mobile robots that transport construction materials on job sites using AI and sensor technology. The robots operate via a subscription-based service model providing deployment, operation, and maintenance.

name: HrdWyr
description: HrdWyr designs artificial intelligence system-on-chip (AISoC) components for edge computing applications. The company creates specialized semiconductor chips for data centers, mobility systems, industrial infrastructure, and consumer devices.

name: ideaForge
description: ideaForge designs and manufactures unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) for defense and civilian applications, including surveillance, mapping, and border security. The company specializes in multi-rotor and hybrid vertical take-off and landing drone systems.

name: Immuneel Therapeutics
description: Immuneel develops CAR-T cell therapies and other cell and gene therapies to treat cancer, with a focus on making advanced immunotherapies more affordable and accessible in India and emerging markets.

name: InspeCity
description: InspeCity develops autonomous in-orbit satellite servicing systems including propulsion, robotic manipulation, and refueling technologies. The company serves satellite operators and space agencies for satellite life extension and orbital debris mitigation.

name: Integra Robotics
description: Integra Robotics manufactures collaborative industrial robots and unmanned ground vehicles powered by AI and teleoperation systems, serving manufacturing, warehousing, security, and defence applications.

name: KshatraLabs
description: KshatraLabs develops autonomous aerial interceptor systems called HAWK that detect, pursue, and neutralize hostile drones and drone swarms at high speeds. The systems are designed for military defense and critical infrastructure protection.

name: Makr Microsystems
description: Makr Microsystems develops nanoscale 3D subsurface metrology technology for semiconductor manufacturers using Acoustic Atomic Force Microscopy and optical tomography to inspect hidden structures and defects within chips at the nanometer scale without damaging them.

name: Mandrake Bio
description: Designs AI-built gene-editing enzymes using computational protein design for agriculture and therapeutics, licensing them to seed and pharmaceutical companies.

name: Mowito
description: Mowito develops AI software that enables standard industrial robot arms to learn and perform manufacturing tasks like precision assembly and machine tending by observing human operators on the factory floor.

name: Skyroot Aerospace
description: Designs and manufactures on-demand space launch vehicles for deploying small satellites to orbit, offering both dedicated and rideshare launch options with custom orbital deployment capabilities.

name: SolarSquare
description: SolarSquare designs and installs rooftop solar panel systems for residential homes, housing societies, and commercial entities. The company provides end-to-end services including design, installation, subsidy paperwork, financing, and maintenance.

name: Solinas Integrity
description: Develops robotic systems for inspecting and cleaning water and sewer pipelines, including crawler robots like Endobot and Homosep. Provides AI-powered analytics platform (SWASTH AI) for infrastructure asset management for municipalities and enterprise customers.

name: StarOps
description: Spacecraft engineering company that develops qualified satellite bus platforms across 50 kg, 150 kg, and 250 kg classes, with proprietary subsystem technologies and over 66% indigenisation of satellite systems.

name: Temple
description: A wearable device worn at the temple that continuously tracks cerebral blood flow and related neurological and metabolic markers, designed to monitor brain performance and health optimization.

name: WATER Robotics
description: Develops robotic furniture with embedded sensors and actuators that adjust and respond to the human body in real time. Their flagship product, CAMA, is an adaptive bed designed for sleep and recovery.

name: Zoppler Systems
description: Develops indigenous RF (radio frequency) sensing products and vendor-agnostic decision and autonomy platforms for defence and dual-use applications across airborne, ground, and naval systems.

name: Zumutor Biologics
description: Zumutor Biologics develops immunotherapies that activate natural killer (NK) cells to attack tumors, with a focus on NK cell checkpoint inhibitors. The company's lead candidate ZM008 is a first-in-class monoclonal antibody designed to unlock innate immune responses against cancer.

name: Aignosis
description: Aignosis is an AI-assisted autism and developmental screening platform that uses computer vision to analyze behavioral signals such as eye gaze and facial expression responses in children aged 16 months to 9 years. The system uses standard laptops and webcams to generate risk reports indicating whether further clinical assessment may be needed.

name: Pixxel
description: Pixxel develops hyperspectral imaging satellites and software (Aurora platform) to process satellite imagery for earth observation. The company serves agriculture, energy, environmental monitoring, mining, and government sectors.

name: Sarla Aviation
description: Develops electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) aircraft for urban air mobility. Their primary product, Shunya, is a six-seat flying taxi designed for urban transportation with hybrid-electric propulsion.
